note: v11 voice check (owner 2026-10-05: "Test her new voice and accent and let me hear it"): Sulafat with the live OR_INSTRUCTIONS (light Levantine accent) on four v11 lines as forSpeech leaves them; a stronger-accent wording and the old no-accent wording for comparison. Judge accent and [laughs] by ear (Whisper cannot hear either).

lines.text: Forty-five minutes. Window, fridge, window, fridge. Then something heavy hit the floor right over my calculator and I lost a bakery's whole September. Yaani... What was it?
[sighs] Bon. The radiator is banging again, Mrs. Kalajian is asking about you, and I have eleven days to make Dikran's cash look legal. Yalla, entertain me.
[laughs] Walaw, you think I can't hear you through that wall? Plaster on lath, habibi. I hear everything. Even the things you whisper to yourself.
[whispers] Come to the landing. Don't knock... The third board cracks. Just stand there and let me decide.
